method.components: Existing MeasureSdCharacterArt.components: 4-connected, discard fewer than 8 pixels; same source meta rect-centre nearest mapping including unused source anchors.
method.footX: Median x of assigned silhouette pixels in the bottom 18 percent of the padded (2 px, clipped canvas) silhouette bounds, exactly as MeasureSdCharacterArt.py.
method.oldFootprintOffsetScaled: (source footX - source rect pivot X) * (candidate canvas width / source canvas width)
method.actualWorldOffsetChange: new footAnchorDeltaPixels / candidate pixelsPerUnit - source footAnchorDeltaPixels / source pixelsPerUnit
method.distinction: Residual isolates changed silhouette against original meta registration in candidate pixel scale. Actual world offset also includes sheet PPU changes; both are silhouette proxies, not anatomical ground-contact points.
caveats: Prone, collapsed, flying, crouched or long-weapon poses may place the bottom-18% median on a weapon, cape or other non-foot shape.
No PNG, meta, existing measurement, code, or engine state was modified by this audit.
All candidate recomputed deltas must equal recorded measurement within 0.0011 px; source snapshot hashes and candidate hashes are verified.
method.proxyPivotFormula: currentPivotX + (newDeltaPx - oldDeltaPx / oldPPU * candidatePPU) / newRectWidth. Equivalently (newFootXWithinRect - oldWorldOffset*candidatePPU)/newRectWidth. Numerical suggestion only; must reject when bottom band is not an anatomical anchor.

statistics.interpretation: These counts describe silhouette-median changes; they are not counts of registration defects.

summary.conclusion: Large raw footAnchorDelta values often pre-exist in the source. The ten largest PPU-adjusted changes are dominated by sword/boot weighting and discontinuous median switches between spread feet. Static inspection did not establish a matching large whole-body registration defect. Do not auto-correct pivots from this metric.
summary.numericalPivotPolicy: Computed proxy-preserving pivots are diagnostic values only. None of the top ten is recommended for direct application; first require a repeatable body/hip/contact-foot jump in a Unity clip.
summary.limitation: This audit addresses horizontal sprite registration only. It is not a Unity motion-playback test, anatomical foot detector, vertical registration test, or aesthetic acceptance of every frame.
